Natural Specimen Collection
Petrified Wood and Mixed Stone Samples
Multiple Dimensions
Unsigned

Petrified wood specimen measures approximately 6.25" x 5.25" x 3.25"
Includes four polished green stone hearts and one unakite heart specimen
Banded onyx blocks feature varied geometric cuts highlighting natural striations
Total collection weight of 12.435 lbs provides a substantial display set
Condition:
Good condition overall. All specimens exhibit natural imperfections, surface scratches, and edge wear consistent with geological origin and handling as noted in the product description. The stones remain stable and structurally sound for display purposes.

Mixed Tumbled Stones
- Assorted varieties including specimens of lapis lazuli, aventurine, and jasper.

Etched Stone
